meta.name: appllama-usage
meta.description: Use the Appllama MCP (mcp.appllama.io) well — research real top-grossing mobile apps, their screens, flows, and UI elements, then build from what you learn. Load when the Appllama MCP is connected and the task involves building a mobile app or screen, researching app design patterns, studying onboarding/paywall/feature flows, improving an existing screen, or whenever an appllama_* / search_apps / list_app_screens tool is available. Covers the tool map, pagination, expiring media, and the full build-from-research playbooks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查真实热门应用界面与流程,边学边做出更好的移动应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做移动应用或界面设计,想借鉴真实热门 App 的做法
copy.tagline_en: Research top-grossing apps' real screens and flows to craft your own mobile UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build mobile apps and want to ground your UI choices in real top-grossing examples

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先查免费额度,再用 Appllama 数据库逐屏研究真实高营收 App 的屏幕、流程与界面元素,把截图与要点整理成笔记,按操作手册把发现用在设计或改进手机界面上,并提醒媒体链接约 1 小时后失效。
howto.when: 当 Appllama MCP 已连接,任务涉及构建或改进手机 App/界面、研究应用设计(如新手引导、付费墙等),或有相关工具可用时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一款喝水提醒 App:先研究营收靠前的同类,再设计首页。
say.note: 先查免费额度,搜索同类 App 逐屏看图,再给首页设计建议。

say.text: 用我粘贴的屏幕 ID 找到那个付费墙,按同类高营收 App 改进它。
say.note: 先用 ID 找到该付费墙屏,再找同类参考后给改进建议。

say.text: 帮我拆解这款 App 的新手引导流程,讲讲它每一步展示了什么。
say.note: 按新手引导流程筛出各屏,逐屏分析后汇总。

howto.what_en: With it on, Claude studies real top-grossing apps' screens, flows and UI elements via Appllama, saves notes with screenshots, follows playbooks to design or improve mobile screens, and warns media links expire in about an hour.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the Appllama MCP is connected and the task involves building or improving a mobile app/screen, researching app design/flow patterns such as onboarding and paywalls, or when an Appllama tool is available.

say_en.text: Research top-grossing water reminder apps, then design a home screen for mine.
say_en.note: It will search apps and capture key screens.

say_en.text: Improve the paywall screen for this screen ID, modeled on top apps.
say_en.note: It will compare similar paywall screens and propose changes.

say_en.text: Analyze this app's onboarding flow and say what each step shows.
say_en.note: It will list the screens by flow and summarize them.
